messages:
dana: main pipeline turned red right after merge of PR #4821, can someone grab? 
ci-bot: [ALERT] pipeline main-smoke failed on stage `gpu-smoke-alloc` (job: j-778). Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/j-778 
anya: on it, grabbing logs now. do we have the failing test name? 
mike: looks like `smoke/allocator/shard_alloc_test` is the culprit from the trace snippet. suspect kv cache allocation interplay. 
dana: @mike can you own? low risk to revert PR but we should triage first. :eyes: 
mike: I'll take it. starting bisect run against the last 6 merges. ping me if you need me to revert. 
ci-bot: rerun queued for job j-778 (user: anya) 
anya: rerun finished — still failing, same stack. pasted tail: ```E 03/08 02:16:45 Allocator: failed to reserve 12.8GB on shard-3
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/tests/smoke_alloc.py", line 128, in run_case
    allocate_shard()
RuntimeError: shard alloc failed
``` 
sarah: quick thought — last merge changed default batchsize in config-service, could reduce per-shard memory. @mike could that explain alloc pressure? 
mike: yep plausible. looking at commit c3f9a2 which bumped `gpu.batch_target` from 8 to 12. that could push working set over threshold for some nodes. 
dana: if revert is fast we can roll back, otherwise bisect to find offending commit faster. what's time for a revert + canary? 
mike: can do hot-revert of just the config change (PR 4823) — I'll open it now and request fast-track. 
ci-bot: bisect job started (b-991). will report first red commit. 
anya: thanks @mike — assigning you in the incident board. I can stand up an extra shard with larger mem if we need a quick mitigation. 
mike: appreciate that. will wait for bisect result before reverting. if it comes back clean, we'll keep digging deeper. 
ci-bot: bisect update: first red commit found c3f9a2 (the batchsize bump) — reproducer matched on 2/3 runs. 
dana: ok that nails it. @mike please proceed with revert PR and canary until we confirm. :thumbsup: 
mike: opened revert PR #4835 and requested fast merge. starting canary in us-west region only. will update when canary either passes or fails. 
anya: queued a temporary config override on canary hosts to lower `gpu.batch_target` to 8 as stopgap. 
sarah: nice, thanks team. keep me posted if anything else fails. 
ci-bot: canary runs: pass (3/3) as of 02:50 UTC — promoting revert. 
dana: great work. closing triage, follow-up: add test that exercises high batch target on small nodes to prevent regression. 
mike: adding test to integration-suite, will link PR.
